intent.proves: At least one order state has an email template.
intent.scope: order states of order type Order

bindings.reason: The state projection is not proven to carry the mail template; handler not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomOrderStates WHERE OrderStateOrderType = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderStateIsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND (ISNULL(OrderStateMailTemplate, N'') <> N'' OR ISNULL(OrderStateOthersMailTemplate, N'') <> N'')
